caption: The drawing is a technical illustration done on a beige or tan background with black and red ink. It depicts two views of a table: one labeled "SIDE VIEW" and the other "END VIEW." The table has six turned legs featuring bulbous and cylindrical shapes with decorative horizontal bars connecting them; the central legs are further joined by a larger connecting bar. In the side view, there is a visible drawer on the right side under the tabletop, which has a keyhole centered on its front. The top surface of the table is rectangular. All measurements are marked in red ink, with the side view indicating a table length of 63 inches and the end view indicating a width of 54 1/4 inches. The dimensions of the spaces between the legs and widths of the different table parts are provided along the bottom and side margins in red ink. In the bottom right corner, a block of text in black ink reads: "TABLE DINING ROOM DANBURY HOUSE CONNECTICUT BROOKLYN MUSEUM #15181." The scale for the drawing (in inches) is displayed near the middle bottom edge, consisting of black-and-white checkered rectangles. At the lower left corner, the artist's name, "E. Holst-Grubbe," is written in small black script. In the upper left corner, the annotation "FU-292" is written in red ink.
title: Gate-legged Table
